cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

mechanism: A uses gracious expert hosting instructions to accommodate an extra diner while making A missed meal and later solitary serving conspicuous.
confusable: D21 grows openly furious; D45 keeps gracious cooperation while ensuring the cost to A cannot be overlooked.
comparison: Bag alternative displays physical strain while helping a traveller; dinner alternative displays delayed eating while sustaining service.
seedUse: Extra brother, sacrificed pie and delayed pizza derive from D45-a; S03 adds guest-first service and correct plating order to the accommodation.
